sentences.text: Rakesh Kumar Yadav vs State Of U.P. And 3 Others on 4 March,

2025 
Author: Saurabh Srivastava
Bench: Saurabh Srivastava
High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad
?Neutral Citation No. - 2025:Ahc:30584
Court No. - 79
Case :- Matters Under Article 227 No. - 16150 of 2024
Petitioner :- Rakesh Kumar Yadav
Respondent :- State Of U.P. And 3 Others
Counsel for Petitioner :- Bashisth Narain Pandey
Counsel for Respondent :- G.A.
Hon'ble Saurabh Srivastava,J.
1. Heard learned counsel for petitioner and learned Aga.
2. Specific prayer has been made through the instant petition that a direction be issued to the
learned court concerned, Basti to decide S.T. No.2515 of 2020, arising out of Case Crime No.159 of
2020, under Sections 498A, 302, 201 Ipc, P.S. Kaptanganj, District Basti, expeditiously.

entities.text: High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: 3. Learned counsel for petitioner submitted that the said case is pending since 2020 before the concerned court at the stage of trial itself wherein petitioner is running from pillar to post to get justice and bring the trial to its logical conclusion but all his efforts have been gone in vain.

entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: 4. Considering the innocuous prayer made by learned for petitioner, process of issuing notices to respondent nos.2 to 4 is hereby dispensed with and at the same time, learned court concerned, Basti is hereby directed to decide S.T. No.2515 of 2020, arising out of Case Crime No.159 of 2020, without granting any unnecessary adjournment to either of the parties but after giving full opportunity of hearing to both sides, expeditiously, preferably within a period of nine months from the date of production of a certified copy of this order, if there is no other legal impediment.
5. In view of the aforesaid direction, the instant petition is disposed of.
